name: cc_discharge_cccv_charge
comment: 1 cycle of: constant-current discharge at 2C to 2.8 V, rest 10 min, CC-CV charge at 2C to 4.2 V (0.1C taper cutoff), rest 10 min. Raise repeat for more cycles and adjust c_rate to the rates you actually want; currents are capped to the cell's limits and the EBC ceiling.
